Select activity_id from activities, assay_chembl_id from assays, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type from activities, and molecule_chembl_id from molecule_dictionary. Join activities to assays on assay_id and to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter where assays.tid = 165 and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by activity_id, assay_chembl_id, molecule_chembl_id.
